        parameters = {
            "name": "Oxygen",
            "molar_mass": 0.032,
            "molar_mass_units": "kg/mol",

            gas_species.pure_vapor_pressure_strategy,
            parameters["vapor_pressure_strategy"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(gas_species.partitioning, parameters["partitioning"])
